## Cleaning data 
```{r}
# clean covariate data to remove labels
# update data types
# 0 = healthy, 1= asthmatic (should I replace num with char?, maybe down the road)
# batch date is still char, note date
covariate_cleaned <- covariate_data %>%
  mutate(
    mat_age_yrs = as.numeric(str_remove(mat_age_yrs, ".*: ")),
    preg_preeclampsia = str_remove(preg_preeclampsia, ".*: "),
    delivery_gestAge_wks = as.numeric(str_remove(delivery_gestAge_wks, ".*: ")),
    sampleCollection_gestAge_wks = as.numeric(str_remove(sampleCollection_gestAge_wks, ".*: ")),
    batch_Microarray = (str_remove(batch_Microarray, ".*: ")),
    mat_BMI = as.numeric(str_remove(mat_BMI, ".*: ")),
    mat_vitD = as.numeric(str_remove(mat_vitD, ".*: ")),
    mat_asthma = as.numeric(str_remove(mat_asthma, ".*: "))
  )

# head(covariate_cleaned)

# nrow(covariate_cleaned) == length(unique(covariate_cleaned$geoID))
```

## Pivot gene expression data longer
```{r}
# pivot gene expression data, rename x to probe id for future join
gene_expression_long <- gene_expression_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 2:158,
      names_to = "geoID",
    values_to = "expression_value") %>%
  rename(PROBEID = X)
# head(gene_expression_long)
```

## Combine data frames
```{r}
# join covariate and expression data on geoid, join gene name on probe id
pregnancy_data <- gene_expression_long %>%
  left_join(covariate_cleaned, by = "geoID") %>%
  left_join(gene_names, by = "PROBEID")

# reorder columns
pregnancy_data <- pregnancy_data %>%
  relocate(GENE, .before = "expression_value")

# head(pregnancy_data)

# update preeclampsia and asthma status to be factors
# first check to make sure there are only the two levels I think there are
# unique(pregnancy_data$preg_preeclampsia)
# unique(pregnancy_data$mat_asthma)

# now mutate to factors
pregnancy_data <- pregnancy_data %>%
  mutate(
    preg_preeclampsia = factor(preg_preeclampsia,
                               levels = c("Normal", "Preeclampsia"), 
                               labels = c("Normal", "Preeclampsia")),
    mat_asthma = factor(mat_asthma,
                        levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Healthy", "Asthmatic"))
  )

# do we have any NAs in this data frame?
# colSums(is.na(pregnancy_data))

```

## Build function
```{r}

# make pretty visuals using artyfarty package
# define palette
# ft_pal <- pal("ft")
fm_pal <- pal("few_medium")




# moved deriving categorical variable out of loop so it is in the data frame
# so when I build table 1, it includes that data (this was incorrect)
# leaving it outside loop bc it still works 
# for selected gene, subset the data and create maternal age categorical variable 
pregnancy_data <- pregnancy_data %>% 
  mutate(mat_age_group = if_else(mat_age_yrs >= 35, "Advanced Age >= 35 Years", 
                                 "Standard Age <35 Years"),
         mat_age_group = factor(mat_age_group,
                                levels = c("Standard Age <35 Years", 
                                           "Advanced Age >= 35 Years"), 
                                labels = c("Standard Age <35 Years", 
                                           "Advanced Age >= 35 Years")))


# define list of genes
genes_of_interest <- c("SHANK2", "PRICKLE3", "FIG4")

# define function to create plots for gene list
build_gene_plots <- function(df, list){
  
  # # define list to store plots in 
  # all_hists   <- list()
  # all_scatts  <- list()
  # all_boxps   <- list()
 
  
   # loop through the genes in the gene list 
  for (gene in list) {
      
    # filter data 
    gene_data <- df %>% 
      filter(GENE == gene)
    
    # calculate sample size for graphs, best practice to exclude NA's
    n_samples <- sum(!is.na(gene_data$expression_value))
    
    # report statistical values on plots 
      # calculate the median for histogram 
      gene_median <- round(median(gene_data$expression_value, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
      # calculate the correlation for scatterplot
      correlation <- round(cor(gene_data$mat_vitD, gene_data$expression_value), 2)
  
    # build histogram
    gene_hist <- ggplot(gene_data, aes(x = expression_value)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = fm_pal[7], color = fm_pal[5], alpha = 0.9) +
      geom_vline(aes(xintercept = median(expression_value, na.rm = TRUE)),
                   color = fm_pal[3], linetype = "dashed", linewidth = .8) +
    theme_ft() +
      labs(
      title = paste("Distribution of", gene, "Gene Expression"),
      subtitle =paste0("n = ", n_samples),
      x = paste0(gene, "Expression"),
      y = "Number of Samples") +
      annotate("text", x = gene_median, y = Inf, label = paste("Median:", gene_median), 
               hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, fontface = "italic", size = 4) +
      theme(
          plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(b = 10), hjust = 0.5),
          axis.title.x  = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
          axis.title.y  = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
          plot.caption  = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0)
        )
    
    # build scatterplot 
    gene_scatt <- ggplot(gene_data, aes(x = mat_vitD, y = expression_value)) +
      geom_point(color = fm_pal[7], alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE,
                  color = fm_pal[3], fill = fm_pal[5], alpha = 0.3, linewidth = .8) +
      theme_ft() +
      labs(
        title = paste(gene, "Expression vs. Maternal Vitamin D"),
        subtitle = paste0("linear fit with 95% confidence intervals; n = ", n_samples),
        x = "Maternal Vitamin D (ng/mL)", 
        y = paste0(gene, " Expression")) +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste("r =", correlation), 
               hjust = 2.5, vjust = 1.5, fontface = "italic", size = 4) +
      theme(
        plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(b = 10), hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x  = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
        axis.title.y  = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
        plot.caption  = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0)
      )
    
    # build boxplot
    gene_boxp <- ggplot(gene_data, aes(x = preg_preeclampsia, y = expression_value, 
                                       fill = mat_age_group)) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7,linewidth = .5,
                   position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
      geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15,
                                                 dodge.width  = 0.8,
                                                 seed = 33),
                 alpha = 0.9, size = 1.0, color = fm_pal[5]) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(fm_pal[7], fm_pal[3])) +
      theme_ft() +
      labs(
        title    = paste(gene,"Expression by Pregnancy Outcome and Maternal Age"),
        subtitle = paste0("n = ", n_samples),
        x        = "Pregnancy Outcome",
        y        = paste(gene, "Expression"),
        fill     = "Maternal Age Group"
      ) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(b = 10), hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x    = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
        axis.title.y    = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10))
      )
    
    # # store plots in lists
    # all_hists[[gene]]   <- gene_hist
    # all_scatts[[gene]]  <- gene_scatt
    # all_boxps[[gene]]   <- gene_boxp
    # 
    # # wrap the plot lists
    # combined_hists   <- wrap_plots(all_hists, ncol = 3)
    # combined_scatts  <- wrap_plots(all_scatts, ncol = 3)
    # combined_boxps   <- wrap_plots(all_boxps, ncol = 3) + 
    #                     plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    #                     theme(legend.position = "bottom")
    
    
    # # return individual plots
    print(gene_hist)
    print(gene_scatt)
    print(gene_boxp)
    
    # # save individual plots once
    # ggsave(paste0("S2_", gene, "_Histogram.png"), plot = gene_hist, width = 6, 
    #        height = 4, dpi = 300)
    # ggsave(paste0("S2_", gene, "_Scatterplot.png"), plot = gene_scatt, width = 6, 
    #        height = 4, dpi = 300)
    # ggsave(paste0("S2_", gene, "_Boxplot.png"), plot = gene_boxp, width = 6, 
    #        height = 4, dpi = 300)
    
   
    # # return combined plots
    # print(combined_hists)
    # print(combined_scatts)
    # print(combined_boxps)
    
    # # save combines plots once
    # ggsave("S2_all_Histograms.png", plot = combined_hists, width = 20, 
    #        height = 5, dpi = 300)
    # ggsave("S2_all_Scatterplots.png", plot = combined_scatts, width = 20, 
    #        height = 5, dpi = 300)
    # ggsave("S2_all_Boxplots.png", plot = combined_boxps, width = 20, 
    #        height = 5, dpi = 300)
    # 
    
  }
}
# run function
  build_gene_plots(pregnancy_data, genes_of_interest)
  
# possible strech goal for next submission -- how can I get r to display the
# sample size for each boxplot box
```

Once cleaned to numeric values, used as.numeric to update character data types to numeric data types

```{r}
# library("table1")

# for safety even tho probably not needed

# create maternal age categorical variable
pregnancy_table_data <- covariate_cleaned %>% 
  mutate(mat_age_group = if_else(mat_age_yrs >= 35, "Advanced Age >= 35 Years", 
                                 "Standard Age <35 Years"),
         mat_age_group = factor(mat_age_group,
                                levels = c("Standard Age <35 Years", 
                                           "Advanced Age >= 35 Years"), 
                                labels = c("Standard Age <35 Years", 
                                           "Advanced Age >= 35 Years")))

# relabel covariate columns for table
label(pregnancy_table_data$mat_age_yrs) <- "Maternal Age (years)"
label(pregnancy_table_data$mat_vitD) <- "Maternal Vitamin D (ng/mL)"
label(pregnancy_table_data$mat_BMI) <- "Maternal BMI (kg/m2)"
label(pregnancy_table_data$mat_age_group) <- "Maternal Age Group"
label(pregnancy_table_data$mat_asthma) <- "Asthma Status"

# build table with covariates, grouped by preeclampsia
pregnancy_table1 <- table1(~ mat_age_yrs + mat_vitD + mat_BMI + mat_age_group + mat_asthma | preg_preeclampsia, 
                           data = pregnancy_table_data)

pregnancy_table1
```

## build heatmap 

```{r}
# pick out genes
heat_map_genes <- c("SHANK2", "PRICKLE2", "PRICKLE3", "FIG4", "NAAA", "EVL", "SET", "SUN3", "JAM2", "ME3")

# make new data frame
heat_map_df <- pregnancy_data %>%
  filter(GENE %in% heat_map_genes) %>%
  select(geoID, GENE, expression_value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = geoID, values_from = expression_value) %>%
  column_to_rownames("GENE")

# prepare annotation bars and rename
column_annot <- pregnancy_data %>%
  select(geoID, preg_preeclampsia, mat_age_group) %>%
  distinct(geoID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("geoID") %>% 
  rename(
    "Pregnancy Outcome" = preg_preeclampsia, 
    "Maternal Age Group" = mat_age_group)
  
# define colors
annotation_colorp <- list(
  "Pregnancy Outcome" = c("Normal" = "#f896d8", "Preeclampsia" = "#72195a"),
  "Maternal Age Group" = c("Standard Age <35 Years" = "#b298dc", "Advanced Age >= 35 Years" = "#b9faf8"))


# build heat map 
# hide ids but show gene name

pheatmap(
  t(scale(t(heat_map_df))), #helps normalize genes to each other, and mean centers
  show_rownames = TRUE,         
  show_colnames = FALSE,          
  annotation_col = column_annot,  
  annotation_colors = annotation_colorp,
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean", 
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  color = viridis(100, option = "G"),
  main = "Heatmap of Gene Expression by Pregnancy Outcome and Age"
)


# need to italicize gene names
# set in latex 
# change margins

#pictogram/ waffle 

```
